messages:
emma_cs: hey — customer hitting 422 on /v1/rerank, payload below. they say it works with competitor. Error: '422 invalid_input: unexpected field "query" in document object'

emma_cs: ```json
{ "query": "what is X", "documents": [ { "id": "d1", "text": "...", "query": "per-doc query?" } ], "candidates": [ { "id":"c1","text":"..." } ] }
```

devin_repro: can you paste the full error body + model + api version?

emma_cs: error body: {"error":"invalid_input","message":"unexpected field 'query' in document object"}
curl: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d @payload.json

ash_engineer: quick note — our rerank schema reserves top-level "query" for the user query. embedding a "query" key inside each document collides with the parser we added last quarter that enforces no reserved keys inside doc objects. that's why you get 422. :eyes:

devin_repro: I reproduced locally. minimal repro: ```json
{"query":"q","documents":[{"id":"1","text":"a","query":"q2"}],"candidates":[]}
```
response: 422 invalid_input: 'query' field reserved for rerank query

emma_cs: customer wants compatibility. can we accept doc-level "query" and map it to metadata automatically? :thumbsup:

ash_engineer: short term: support can rewrite payload to move document.query -> document.metadata.query and retry. long term: we'll add clearer validation message and doc update. will open ENG ticket and PR to change error text and add migration note. adding as @ticket-12345

support_bot: ticket created: CS-7892. Steps for support: 1) if doc has 'query', move it to metadata and retry. 2) ask if they need per-document queries — we recommend using a per-passage field instead. 3) escalate if both top-level and doc-level queries exist.
